verdict.rationale: Skills have their own programmatic surface: a Skills API to upload and manage custom skills, a Skill Versions API, attaching up to 20 skills per Messages API request via the `container` parameter, and Agent SDK controls for invoking and loading skills and plugins. No evidence explicitly claims or demonstrates full parity with the Claude.ai UI, so 'everything' is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI feature parity, evidence that UI-side skill operations (enable/disable, sharing) are API-exposed, independent hands-on corroboration of the Skills API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
